messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High p99 latency (6.2s) for tenant `acme-corp` on dedicated cluster `dedicated-eu-west-2-5`. Error rate spike to 3.8% over last 5m. Reserved pool usage 94%. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-tenant-capacity>
PagerDuty: Triggered -> Incident INC-8942, Priority: P1, Escalation policy: oncall-weekday
Maria K. (oncall): Acked @pagerduty. I'm taking initial lead. I'm on my way in.
Alex R.: On call rotation but available. tagging in case escalation needed. @Maria any initial impact details? customer-facing?
Maria K. (oncall): Early telemetry: 25% of requests for `acme-corp` hitting model fallback with timeouts, increased 5xx logs showing `KV cache OOM` and `batch timeout`. Customers reporting slow responses, not complete outages. Jess can confirm if they're contacting support.
Jess L. (CS): Getting a couple escalations from acme support. They're seeing slow responses in production. Asking if there's an ETA. I'll keep them updated with a short summary.
Maria K. (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-critical background inference for that tenant, 2) increase reserved pool size by +1 GPU node temporarily, 3) route a small percentage to compatible model variant that uses smaller KV footprint. Doing steps 1 & 2 now.
infra-bot: Rolling scale: `redwoodctl cluster scale --cluster dedicated-eu-west-2-5 --pool reserved --delta 1` -> started (job id 7321)
Maria K. (oncall): Pasting relevant log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T10:31:02Z [runtime] tenant=acme-corp seq=4096 error=KVCacheOOM keyspace=3
2026-03-14T10:31:03Z [proxy] batch_timeout tenant=acme-corp size=8 latency=6200ms
2026-03-14T10:31:04Z [router] fallback_to_variant tenant=acme-corp model=redwood-small reason=capacity
```
Alex R.: Good. If scaling takes >2m, we should force-deploy fallback routing immediately to reduce tail latency. Suggest rollout 10% -> 50% if stable. Will prepare a canary route.
Maria K. (oncall): Implementing canary route now. Command:
```
redwoodctl route update --cluster dedicated-eu-west-2-5 --tenant acme-corp --route canary --variant redwood-small --percent 10
```
infra-bot: Route update accepted (task 9846). Applying...
PagerDuty: INC-8942 acknowledged by Maria K.
Sam P.: Looping in infra on-call for kernel-level memory pressure checks. @infra-bot can you confirm node memory usage across reserved pool?
infra-bot: Node summary: 4/4 reserved nodes at 92-96% GPU mem; one node with transient OOMs flagged. Eviction not triggered. Scaling job 7321 completed, new node joined: reserved-5
Maria K. (oncall): New node up. Re-running warmup for KV cache; should reduce OOMs. Increasing canary to 30%.
redwoodctl: Route update --percent -> 30% applied (task 9870)
Maria K. (oncall): Monitoring p99 and error rate. p99 dropping: 6.2s -> 3.1s, errors 3.8% -> 1.2% over 3m.
Jess L. (CS): Telling acme support: "We're currently mitigating increased latency by scaling reserved capacity and routing a small portion of traffic to a lower-memory model. We expect visible improvement in ~5 minutes. No customer data exposure. Will follow up with post-incident notes." They want an ETA; I gave ~10m conservative.
Alex R.: Nice work. Two follow-ups: 1) create short-term alert to auto-scale earlier if reserved pool >90% for 3m, 2) add a regression test for KV cache growth for large-seq requests in Dedicated tenants.
Maria K. (oncall): Agree. I'll file the alert after stabilizing. For now p99 = 2.9s, errors = 0.6%, reserved usage = 86%.
PagerDuty: Escalation timer reset. Next on-call: Alex R. in 18 minutes.
Maria K. (oncall): Handoff to Alex in 15. Summary for next: started w/ high p99 and KVCacheOOMs for acme-corp on dedicated-eu-west-2-5. Actions taken: scaled reserved pool +1 node, applied canary routing to redwood-small (10% -> 30%), throttled background jobs. Observed p99 and errors decreasing. Current status: degraded but improving. Links: runbook + logs + dashboard: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-8942>
Alex R.: Thanks. I'll be on for the next 30m. If anything regresses, escalate to infra-sre and prepare to spin an emergency isolated pool for the tenant. Also reaching out to model-ops to check quantization profile used by redwood-small for compatibility.
Sam P.: Noted. I'll start a post-mortem template and capture timeline. Also will check if autoscaler thresholds are tuned for spike patterns from large queries.
Jess L. (CS): Acme support updated. They appreciate the quick mitigation. Asking for a follow-up call tomorrow to review prevention steps.
Maria K. (oncall): OK closing the page for now. Monitoring trace continues. If p99 < 2.0s and errors < 0.5% for 15m, we'll mark as resolved.
infra-bot: Monitoring rule: p99 under 2.0s and error_rate under 0.5% maintained for 15m -> will auto-resolve.
Maria K. (oncall): Marking this thread resolved for now. Nice teamwork. :team-heart:
Alex R.: Thanks all. I'll take the ownership for the post-incident follow-ups.
Jess L. (CS): Scheduling customer follow-up.
end of thread
